description: Open-license artistic inspiration-board photography assets for SelfMediaSplashScreen. The set favors reference-like visual fragments: refracted color, abstract light, water/texture, soft landscapes, organic details, eye/face fragments, and reflections. Ordinary event photos, signage, clocks, literal animal shots, screenshots, and posters are filtered out.

selectionMethod.source: Openverse image search across fine-art, macro, refraction, portrait-fragment, landscape-abstraction, and spatial-detail themes
visualSignals: suitability as a small rounded inspiration card
selectionMethod.postProcessing: Resized to max 760px; high-saturation files were gently desaturated and contrast was mildly softened.
